name: Mateo Sepúlveda
bio:
Mateo's journey into motorsport began unconventionally. Growing up in Santiago, he initially pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, but his fascination with vehicle safety led him to specialize in security systems. A chance encounter at a local rally event ignited his passion for racing, prompting him to redirect his skills toward motorsport. He started volunteering at regional races, quickly gaining a reputation for his meticulous approach and technical expertise.

His dedication caught the eye of VW Racing Brasil, who recognized his potential to enhance their security protocols. Mateo is known for his proactive approach, constantly seeking innovative solutions to safeguard the team's assets and personnel. He believes in a collaborative security model, working closely with team members to foster a culture of safety awareness. His ability to anticipate and mitigate potential risks makes him a valuable asset to the team.

Mateo distinguishes himself with his blend of technical prowess and interpersonal skills. He is not just a security expert; he's a team player who understands the unique demands of the racing environment.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight wave.
physical.description: Mateo is of medium build with a focused gaze that reflects his analytical mind.

quirks: Always carries a small multi-tool, even in meetings.
Has a habit of sketching security diagrams during downtime.
Insists on conducting a thorough security check of his office before leaving for the day, regardless of how late it is.
